instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Regional public health authority responsible for epidemiological surveillance, health promotion programs, and healthcare resource planning for a region of 1.2 million inhabitants. Managing 15 public health programs. Key innovation priority is real-time disease surveillance using syndromic data integration from primary care and hospital networks. Enterprise-scale organization with complex multi-layer governance, dedicated innovation/R&D departments, and formal stage-gate project approval processes.
answers.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality. We built an MVP with an external agency in 3 months, but customer adoption was disappointing — only 8% of customers created accounts. We did not invest enough in understanding whether our specific customer base actually wanted self-service before building.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.additionalContext: We are planning an IPO within 24 months and need to demonstrate a track record of innovation-driven growth to public market investors. The CFO has asked for a 3-year innovation investment plan with clear KPIs that can be included in our equity story and analyst presentations. Bonus points for initiatives that improve our ESG metrics, as this is a key focus area for the listing venue.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.

opportunities.title: Syndromic Data Integration Optimization
opportunities.rationale: Focus on incrementally improving the reliability and speed of real-time disease surveillance data processing using existing analytical tools rather than building entirely new systems.

first_actions: Conduct a 30-day audit of current data pipeline latency bottlenecks.
Implement incremental fine-tuning of machine learning models for early warning signal detection.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in critical alert latency by 15% within Q3.
milestones: Q1: Complete performance baseline audit and identify top three bottlenecks.
Q2: Implement model tuning to achieve a measurable reduction in false positives.

opportunities.title: Adjacent Wellness Platform Entry (Diversification)
opportunities.rationale: Leverage existing public health data assets to launch a niche, subscription-based wellness and preventative care service targeting high-risk demographic segments not currently served by government programs.

first_actions: Conduct a market sizing study for an adjacent preventative care service.
Form a small cross-functional task force (IT, clinical ops, marketing).
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 5% subscription adoption rate among target demographic within the first year.
milestones: Q1: Finalize business model and regulatory pathway for health service offering.
Q4: Launch pilot program in one defined geographic zone.

opportunities.title: Process Automation for Stakeholder Reporting
opportunities.rationale: Automate the manual steps involved in generating standardized reports required by various regulatory bodies, reducing administrative overhead and improving efficiency.

first_actions: Identify the top three most time-consuming reporting processes.
Pilot a low-code automation tool for data aggregation.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce manual report generation time by 40% for key regulatory filings.
milestones: Q2: Complete process mapping and tool selection.
Q3: Deploy pilot automation across one reporting stream.

next_steps.action: Establish a cross-functional steering committee to formally define the scope and risk profile for the 'Adjacent Wellness Platform' radical opportunity.
Conduct a detailed budget feasibility study and talent gap analysis specifically for the Q1-Q2 optimization of existing syndromic data models.

key_weaknesses: Informal innovation process leading to inconsistent resource allocation and unclear prioritization.
High organizational inertia hindering the adoption of new technologies despite available budget resources.
Lack of clear talent pipeline specifically skilled in applying digital tools within complex public sector governance structures.
